retrieval_policy.current_job: Use only the supplied catalog snapshot and locally authored kickoff artifacts. No network or source-repository content retrieval was performed.
later_expansion: Start with the cataloged HTTPS MIT OpenCourseWare URLs and remain on public, official resources.
Do not authenticate, bypass access controls, fetch restricted content, or copy hidden, sealed, or learner-specific files.
Treat links and descriptive pointers as unverified until a successful retrieval is recorded.

Before assigning retrieved material, record its canonical URL, course edition, title, public access status, applicable license or terms, retrieval provenance, and a content digest for downloaded artifacts.
Classify each item as an instructional unit, supporting resource, index, or unresolved pointer; normalization alone is not promotion to an official unit.
Leave missing or ambiguous items blocked rather than substituting guessed content.
retrieval_policy.promotion_rule: A later job may change an availability label only when deterministic retrieval and classification evidence is stored with the artifact.
retrieval_policy.fallback: The current manager-authored kickoff remains usable without any external material; official-course expansion waits for separately validated retrieval.
